name: inspect_signature
description: Inspect the selected Mach-O architecture's code-signing identity, hashes, authorities, designated requirement, entitlements and hardened-runtime state from a temporary digest-verified byte snapshot. Other slices are checked for unsigned state, with their metadata coverage stated separately. Exact command provenance is retained. native_command_timeout_ms is each codesign command's wall clock (omitted means 60000 ms). It does not raise the fixed 67108864-byte output allowance.
